{{Quote|Are you willing to give up your weapon to do this?"<br>"I'm not happy about it, but I don't see another choice.|[[I-5YQ]] and [[Jax Pavan]]|<ref name="CNI:JT" />}}
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] used a [[Color/Legends|blue]] '''[[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]'''. Jax constructed his lightsaber roughly three months before the [[Order 66/Legends|fall of the Jedi]] when he was promoted to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], the lightsaber being his first. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] the lightsaber was among Pavan's various other weapons. He kept it in an inside pocket in his greatcoat, using a small [[confounder unit]] to keep it from being detected on routine scans. He used this lightsaber on various occasions. When [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] found him at the [[Coruscant Arms]], when escaping from [[Rokko]], when being chased by [[Police cruiser backup unit|PCBU's]], when chasing [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and [[10-4TO]] and when fighting [[Feral droid|feral]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. When Jax and his comrades, [[Laranth Tarak]], [[Den Dhur]], and [[I-5YQ]] were captured by Xizor, the prince took Jax's weapon and went to kill Jax with it, only for I-Five to stop Xizor with an ear-piercing screech. Xizor soon after used the lightsaber to duel Pavan, who used a [[Jax Pavan's lightwhip|lightwhip]]. Pavan barely won the fight and reclaimed his lightsaber while Xizor escaped. Then sensing the approach of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Pavan formed a plan to get Vader off his tail and hopefully kill the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. He handed his lightsaber to I-Five who purposely dropped it in a specific spot so it would strike a reactor, causing a large explosion.<ref name="CNI:JT" />

The lightsaber's blade was adjustable and featured a lock button. The lock button let the blade stay powered even when no one was holding it.<ref name="CNI:JT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lightsaber first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''. However, on the cover of ''Jedi Twilight'', the lightsaber is incorrectly shown to be orange instead of blue.<ref name="CNI:JT" />
